journey.name: scan onchain amount to confirm
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain BIP21 request with an amount the Savings balance covers opens the Confirm screen directly, with the amount, recipient and fee filled in, and that Back from Confirm opens Amount with the same amount so it can still be edited. Nothing is broadcast. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with between 200 000 and 1 000 000 confirmed sats in Savings, funded through the lsp regtest deposit and mine (see ../README.md), Coin Selection set to Autopilot (the default), no hardware wallet selected, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Manual coin selection keeps going through Amount and then the coin selection screen; see ../coin-selection/manual-coin-selection.xml. Start on the wallet home screen. The Confirm screen is identified by its "Confirm" title and the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount"); the Send Amount screen by its number field (testTag "SendNumberField").

actions.action: Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" to.bitkit.dev

Verify the Confirm screen opens without the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") having been shown, and the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount") shows 10 000, waiting through "Connecting to network" if it is shown
Tap Show Details (testTag "SendConfirmToggleDetails") and verify the recipient (testTag "ReviewUri") is the regtest address and Speed and Fee shows a fee
Verify the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") is visible with 10 000 sats
Tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount") and verify the Confirm screen shows 10 000 again
Tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the Send Amount screen is visible, then tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the wallet home screen is visible without sending

Open Send (testTag "Send"), choose Enter Manually (testTag "RecipientManual"), enter "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.0001" into the recipient field (testTag "RecipientInput") and tap Continue (testTag "AddressContinue")
Verify the Confirm screen opens directly showing 10 000

Tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the Send Amount screen shows 10 000, then tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the recipient field still holds the URI; close the sheet without sending
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0.01" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the Insufficient Savings toast appears (screenshot) and neither the Send Amount nor the Confirm screen opens
